data_manifest.description: Conservative combination holdout; frozen inherited vocabulary; retrain from random initialization only

source.note: Public weekly export; contributor names and sentence IDs retained in prepared data. Transcriptions without a username are not marked reviewed by Tatoeba.

data_manifest.split_strategy: Normalized bodies partitioned by SHA256 before train-only vocabulary selection; older held-out bodies protected

teacher.role: offline training teacher only; never packaged for application inference

synthetic_sources.inference_use: none; prompts and teacher never used by deployed student

data_manifest.teacher_split_strategy: SHA256 normalized body: 90% train/5% validation/5% test; all prior bodies excluded

combination_holdout.initialization: random only; no prior task-trained checkpoint

split_audit.scope: NFKC + terminal period only; not semantic, paraphrase or combination disjointness

protocol: Independent request pools, seed = start + request_id*4 + candidate_index; shared prefixes for N=1/2/4. Mean unmasked student log probability of content + period + EOS; excludes difficulty prediction. No training-reference lookup. Ties prefer first candidate. Scores are not naturalness or reading accuracy.
quality: pending independent human review; student likelihood is not quality
